# Garage Sale Listings

> A community garage sale kit for real estate agents. The kit covers the timeline, signup form, neighborhood map, flyers, signs and follow up scripts an agent needs to run one neighborhood sale and meet the sellers on the street. Run by Clark Richardson.

## Main pages
- [Home: community garage sale kit for real estate agents](https://garagesaleagents.com/): what the kit includes, price, free guide and FAQ.
- [Free guide (PDF)](https://garagesaleagents.com/guide/be_the_agent_they_already_know.pdf)

## Planning guides
- [How to Run a Community Garage Sale as a Real Estate Agent](https://garagesaleagents.com/how-to-run-a-community-garage-sale-as-an-agent/): The full step by step plan for agents.
- [Community Garage Sale Cost for Agents: What Drives It](https://garagesaleagents.com/community-garage-sale-cost/): What drives the cost for an agent, line by line.
- [HOA and City Garage Sale Rules for Real Estate Agents](https://garagesaleagents.com/hoa-and-city-garage-sale-rules/): What to check with the board and the city before you announce.
- [Community Garage Sale Timeline: An 8 Week Plan](https://garagesaleagents.com/community-garage-sale-timeline/): What to do each week, from picking a date to follow up.
- [Community Garage Sale FAQ for Real Estate Agents](https://garagesaleagents.com/faq/): Answers about the kit, planning, cost, and rules.

## Related
- [Community Sale Help](https://communitysalehelp.com/): we run community garage sales for HOAs and neighborhood groups.
